Title/concept (do not letter): Riven Hale
Age: 27
Gender: man
Complexion: Light cool complexion.
Face: Narrow adult face, heavy-lidded eyes, straight nose, restrained crooked smile.
Hair: Collar-length silver hair swept backward, not a bob.
Build: Tall, lean, long-legged athletic adult.

Requested visual: Tall lean long-legged build; a narrow face with heavy-lidded eyes and a restrained crooked smile; collar-length silver hair swept backward. Deep petrol cropped combat jacket over fitted charcoal high-neck layer, one practical black shoulder shell, straight tapered trousers and flat armored boots. Stand lightly on the front foot, saber carried low outside the body with one clearly wrapped hand; the other hand relaxed. Future growth is copy context only; do not depict simultaneous upgrades: Cross one broken walkway.; Carry momentum through a seam into a precisely timed counter.; Pass a guarded spatial boundary by recognizing its hidden continuation.
